description: MCP server for Claude (Claude in Chrome, claude.ai): save Facebook posts to NocoDB content_ideation.fb_posts and search them for content ideation.
name: Content ideation MCP

parameters.instructions:
Tools for the user's library of Facebook posts kept as references for content ideation (NocoDB table content_ideation.fb_posts, one row per post_url).

Before save_facebook_post: expand "See more" so the text is complete, open the comments (switch to "All comments" or "Most relevant" as the user asks) and expand replies you want to keep. Saving a post that is already stored updates it; empty values never overwrite stored ones.

Use find_facebook_posts to check whether a post is saved or to pull references when the user brainstorms content.

parameters.description: Save one Facebook post (text, engagement, comments) as a content reference. Creates the row, or updates it when post_url is already saved. Returns status created or updated.

parameters.toolDescription: Search saved Facebook reference posts, newest capture first. Columns: post_url, hook, author_name, author_url, source_type, posted_at, format, text, reactions, comment_count, shares, comments, why_it_works, notes, captured_at.
